'''2012 European Championship Dan Price LS A Good Blaster To Have On Your Side''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Dan Price]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[A Good Blaster To Have On Your Side]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
